mode: External FAT directory; no embedded game and no runtime ZIP reader
build: devkitPro/devkitARM + libnds + libfat. Run build.bat or make. No game files needed at build time.
prepare: Use preparegame.py v2.1. Open ZIP/JAR, select a language, optionally Check Error, then Create Game Folder. Copy zenonia2nds/ to the flashcard root.
resources: All native game assets and optional runner_audio cache resolve under the one selected /zenonia2nds/ directory; no fallback to embedded ROM files.
save: Existing ZKR1.sav remains outside the game directory on FAT; replacing prepared assets does not overwrite this save.
supported: Known Zenonia 2 LGT WIPI ARM layout and language variants only; existing per-game compatibility hooks retained.
not_yet_verified: Full ARM compilation in this environment (devkitARM absent)
DS Fat/R4 or DSi hardware execution of this new build
tests: bash tests/run_flashcard_tests.sh; other historical native tests need user-supplied game fixtures.
language_switch: Selecting a language replaces zenonia2nds/; compatible translations do not require recompiling the NDS.
old_rom: Older NitroFS-based NDS builds do not read this folder. Build the new runner first.
optional_audio: The tool exports original assets only. Optional runner_audio/title108.zpc can be regenerated with tools/render_title_pcm.py after preparing zenonia2nds/. Missing cache uses the existing synth fallback.
english: en/ is included beside Makefile. Place preparegame.py beside Makefile to use it. Existing edits are never overwritten.
translation_check: Check Error only validates translations and writes error.txt when errors exist. KR is the original language and skips translation validation.
